function.name: IT operations and security
function.description: Internal requests, alerts, access and internal knowledge.

jobs.name: Answer questions from the company's internal knowledge
jobs.outcome: A question about how things work here is answered from the wiki and documents, with the source, or routed.

jobs.name: Detect anomalous access to systems and data
jobs.outcome: Logins and data access that break a user's pattern are flagged for review before harm.

jobs.name: Resolve routine IT requests without a technician
jobs.outcome: Password resets, access requests and how-do-I questions are resolved end to end with no technician.

jobs.name: Triage monitoring alerts to the right responder
jobs.outcome: Alerts are deduplicated, grouped and routed to the right responder with the context to act.
